name: SameBoy
description: Unsigned version|url manifest → downloads ZIP, swaps over running bundle, STRIPS com.apple.quarantine recursively + chowns as root. No hash/sig.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: SameBoy's macOS updater uses an HTTPS version response and does not show an artifact hash or signature check in the reviewed update path; the broader installation and release-signing boundary remains outside this evidence.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot at the recorded commit, not the original study release; the remote manifest and released ZIP signing state were not independently audited.

original_evidence.text: | SameBoy (macOS) | github.com/LIJI32/SameBoy | Cocoa (Objective-C) macOS app | Y | **auto chk** (opt-in prompt on first launch — "Should SameBoy check for updates when launched?" — defaults the setting from the user's answer, `GBAutoUpdatesEnabled`) + **manual dl/inst** (user clicks "Yes"/"Install" in the update dialog to trigger download and, separately, install) | **Y — confirmed.** `installUpdate:` downloads a ZIP via `NSURLSession downloadTaskWithURL:` from a URL returned by the (unsigned) version-check response, shells out to `/usr/bin/unzip` via `NSTask` to extract it, then `performUpgrade` moves the extracted `SameBoy.app/Contents` directory over the running app bundle's own `Contents`, **explicitly strips the `com.apple.quarantine` extended attribute recursively from the entire bundle** ("so we don't have to escape translocation"), and relaunches via `execl(...,"--update-launch",...)`. If GateKeeper is on or the bundle isn't writable, it acquires root via the legacy `AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges` API and `chown -R`s the bundle to the current user first | HTTPS (`#define UPDATE_SERVER "https://sameboy.github.io"`, GitHub Pages) via `NSURLSession`; no `ignoreSslErrors`/custom trust-evaluation delegate found — TLS validation appears enforced | N — `checkForUpdates` GETs `UPDATE_SERVER/latest_version`, a plain-text response parsed as `"<version>|<url>"` split on `\|`; no signature over this manifest | **none** — repo-wide grep for `SecStaticCodeCheckValidity`, `CC_SHA*`, `codesign`, `SecCode`, `SHA256`, `checksum` in `Cocoa/GBApp.m` returns zero matches; the downloaded ZIP/app bundle is never hashed or code-signature-checked before being installed and the quarantine flag is affirmatively removed | N/A (no key exists — no signature scheme is used at all) | `Cocoa/GBApp.m:14` (`#define UPDATE_SERVER "https://sameboy.github.io"`); `:447-467` (`checkForUpdates`, unsigned `"ver|url"` manifest); `:533-620` (`installUpdate:` — `NSURLSession downloadTaskWithURL:_updateURL`, `/usr/bin/unzip` via `NSTask`, `AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges`/`chown -R` for GateKeeper/write-access); `:622-684` (`performUpgrade` — swaps `Contents`, then `removexattr(bundlePath.UTF8String, "com.apple.quarantine", 0)` recursively over every file in the bundle, then `execl(...)` relaunch) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: **auto chk** (opt-in prompt on first launch — "Should SameBoy check for updates when launched?" — defaults the setting from the user's answer, `GBAutoUpdatesEnabled`) + **manual dl/inst** (user clicks "Yes"/"Install" in the update dialog to trigger download and, separately, install)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: **Y — confirmed.** `installUpdate:` downloads a ZIP via `NSURLSession downloadTaskWithURL:` from a URL returned by the (unsigned) version-check response, shells out to `/usr/bin/unzip` via `NSTask` to extract it, then `performUpgrade` moves the extracted `SameBoy.app/Contents` directory over the running app bundle's own `Contents`, **explicitly strips the `com.apple.quarantine` extended attribute recursively from the entire bundle** ("so we don't have to escape translocation"), and relaunches via `execl(...,"--update-launch",...)`. If GateKeeper is on or the bundle isn't writable, it acquires root via the legacy `AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges` API and `chown -R`s the bundle to the current user first

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS (`#define UPDATE_SERVER "https://sameboy.github.io"`, GitHub Pages) via `NSURLSession`; no `ignoreSslErrors`/custom trust-evaluation delegate found — TLS validation appears enforced

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N — `checkForUpdates` GETs `UPDATE_SERVER/latest_version`, a plain-text response parsed as `"<version>|<url>"` split on `\|`; no signature over this manifest

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **none** — repo-wide grep for `SecStaticCodeCheckValidity`, `CC_SHA*`, `codesign`, `SecCode`, `SHA256`, `checksum` in `Cocoa/GBApp.m` returns zero matches; the downloaded ZIP/app bundle is never hashed or code-signature-checked before being installed and the quarantine flag is affirmatively removed

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: N/A (no key exists — no signature scheme is used at all)

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: `Cocoa/GBApp.m:14` (`#define UPDATE_SERVER "https://sameboy.github.io"`); `:447-467` (`checkForUpdates`, unsigned `"ver|url"` manifest); `:533-620` (`installUpdate:` — `NSURLSession downloadTaskWithURL:_updateURL`, `/usr/bin/unzip` via `NSTask`, `AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges`/`chown -R` for GateKeeper/write-access); `:622-684` (`performUpgrade` — swaps `Contents`, then `removexattr(bundlePath.UTF8String, "com.apple.quarantine", 0)` recursively over every file in the bundle, then `execl(...)` relaunch)
